title: Jeevamrutha Organic Fertilizer Calculator
problem: Abba wants to make natural cow dung fertilizer, but he forgets the exact amount of jaggery and besan flour needed for 1 acre of land.
idea: A calculator where the farmer types land size in acres and gets the amount of each ingredient for Jeevamrutha, using the common recipe for one acre.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: Ingredients for my land
widgets.intro: Common recipe for 1 acre: 200 L water, 10 kg fresh cow dung, 5–10 L cow urine, 1–2 kg jaggery, 1–2 kg besan (pulse flour) and a handful of soil from the field bund. Change the acres below.
widgets.formula: if (acres <= 0) return null; return {water: acres * 200, dung: acres * 10, urine: acres * 5, urine2: acres * 10, jag: acres * 1, jag2: acres * 2, besan: acres * 1, besan2: acres * 2, soil: acres, level: 'good'};
widgets.result:
💧 Water: {water} litres
🐄 Fresh cow dung: {dung} kg
🫗 Cow urine: {urine} to {urine2} litres
🍯 Jaggery: {jag} to {jag2} kg
🫘 Besan flour: {besan} to {besan2} kg
🤎 Field bund soil: {soil} handful(s)

items.title: Take a drum
items.text: Use a plastic or cement drum kept in the shade.
items.te: నీడలో ప్లాస్టిక్ లేదా సిమెంట్ డ్రమ్ తీసుకోండి.

items.title: Add everything
items.text: Put water, dung, urine, jaggery, besan and soil in the drum.
items.te: నీళ్ళు, పేడ, మూత్రం, బెల్లం, శనగపిండి, మట్టి డ్రమ్‌లో వేయండి.

items.title: Stir well
items.text: Stir clockwise with a stick for a few minutes, twice a day.

items.title: Cover and wait
items.text: Cover with a jute bag and keep it for 2 to 7 days.
items.te: గోనె సంచి కప్పి 2 నుండి 7 రోజులు ఉంచండి.

items.title: Use it
items.text: Give it with irrigation water or spray after filtering. Use within about a week.
items.te: నీటితో కలిపి పొలానికి ఇవ్వండి. వారంలోపు వాడండి.

questions.q: How much water for 1 acre of Jeevamrutha?
questions.why: The common recipe uses about 200 litres of water per acre.

options: To make it sweet for cows
questions.why: Jaggery is food for the good microbes that grow in the mix.

questions.q: Where should the drum be kept?
questions.why: Shade keeps the good microbes alive.

how: Ask Gemini or the Agriculture Officer for the standard Jeevamrutha recipe for 1 acre.
Open Scratch and make a variable 'acres'.
Use an 'ask' block: 'How many acres?' and save the answer.
Make the sprite say: water = acres × 200, dung = acres × 10, jaggery = acres × 1 to 2, and so on.
Add a cow sprite and Telugu text with help from Gemini.
Test with 1, 2 and 5 acres and check the answers with Abba.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Give me the common Jeevamrutha organic fertilizer recipe for 1 acre (water, cow dung, cow urine, jaggery, pulse flour, soil) in a simple table, with mixing steps in English and Telugu. Then show the amounts for 2 acres and 5 acres.
